## Why This Is Asked
Tests understanding of incremental rehashing, amortized analysis, and practical cache effects in a growing hash map. Requires deriving bounds and discussing constants.

## Key Concepts
- Incremental rehashing: spread work across operations
- Amortized analysis: cost spread over inserts
- Cache locality: effects of moving buckets in batches

## Code Example
```javascript
class IncrementalHashMap {
  constructor(){ this.A = new Map(); this.B = new Map(); this.moving = 0; }
  insert(k,v){ /* move buckets in batches, then insert into A */ }
  lookup(k){ /* search A then B if needed */ }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would concurrency change the amortized guarantees?
- What heuristics for B balance throughput and cache performance?

```javascript
// GK sketch interface example (pseudocode)

```
